title: Piri Reis Map Enigma

scenes.text: A 1513 world map shows Antarctica before it was discovered.
scenes.query: old parchment world map close up

scenes.text: Many claim the map proves ancient civilizations had advanced global knowledge.
scenes.label: Ancients knew Antarctica

scenes.text: Scholars say the coastline is a misinterpretation of South America and artistic embellishment.
scenes.label: Cartographic error, not proof

scenes.text: Maps reflect the knowledge of their time, not lost technology.
scenes.label: Map limits
scenes.sub: Old maps often guessed unknown lands

description: The Piri Reis map sparks wild theories, but experts see simple cartographic mistakes. Dive into the real story behind this famous chart. Follow for more myth‑busting mysteries.
